correctness.rationale: Every product lies in the square of the triangular radical. Matrix-power path support isolates exactly one top entry for odd size and three for even size; first-superdiagonal independent variables and the first-/last-zero conditioning determine all corner coefficients. The uniform linear-form dichotomy proves the exact formula, with asymptotic geometric-sum control. Independent finite direct-band and linear-form enumerations agree at nine tests.

originality.rationale: The closest publicly accessible whole-result comparison treats unrestricted upper triangular factors conditioned on a nilpotent product, explicitly not two already-nilpotent factors; its extremal index is n rather than ceil(n/2). Single-matrix Jordan tables and nonsingular factorization theorems do not imply our weighted strict-product formula. Search is not a proof of priority.

value.rationale: The maximal nilpotency index is a canonical invariant of any nilpotent semigroup product; the exact all-size all-field extremal probability reveals a sharp even/odd discrepancy with a factor growing linearly with dimension, distinguishing factored from uniform radical elements. This is not an arbitrary finite slice or a restatement of the radical filtration bound.
